module_summary: Per-ID FIFO queue: a head-tail table maps each ID to head/tail indices of linked lists in a shared linked-data pool, with free-slot search, push/pop by ID and a masked data exists-lookup.

anchors.name: head_tail_q
anchors.why: Head-tail table storing per-ID head/tail pointers and free bit of each subqueue.

anchors.name: linked_data_q
anchors.why: Linked data pool storing data, next pointer and free bit per entry.

anchors.name: match_in_idx
anchors.why: Head-tail index matching the requested ID; selects subqueue for append or pop.

anchors.name: head_tail_free_idx
anchors.why: First free head-tail slot for allocating a new ID entry.

anchors.name: linked_data_free_idx
anchors.why: First free linked-data slot where incoming data is written.

anchors.name: no_in_id_match
anchors.why: ID miss flag: allocates new head-tail entry on push, suppresses output on pop.

anchors.name: full
anchors.why: No free linked-data entry; blocks pushes and drops input grant.

anchors.name: inp_req_i
anchors.why: Push request inserting data into the ID subqueue.

anchors.name: inp_gnt_o
anchors.why: Push grant when pool not full.

anchors.name: inp_data_i
anchors.why: Pushed data written into free linked-data entry.

anchors.name: inp_id_i
anchors.why: ID of pushed data, matched against head-tail table.

anchors.name: oup_req_i
anchors.why: Output read request for an ID's head entry.

anchors.name: oup_id_i
anchors.why: ID whose subqueue head is read or popped.

anchors.name: oup_pop_i
anchors.why: Pop command freeing head entry and advancing subqueue head.

anchors.name: oup_data_o
anchors.why: Head data of requested ID's subqueue.

anchors.name: oup_data_valid_o
anchors.why: Indicates requested ID existed and output data is valid.

anchors.name: oup_gnt_o
anchors.why: Output request grant, always given when requested.

anchors.name: exists_req_i
anchors.why: Exists-lookup request per compare port.

anchors.name: exists_o
anchors.why: Lookup result: some occupied entry matches masked query data.

anchors.name: empty_o
anchors.why: Queue-empty status output (all linked-data entries free).

groups.name: Head-tail table
groups.description: ID-to-subqueue head/tail table with ID match and free-slot search.

groups.name: Linked data pool
groups.description: Shared pool of data entries chained by next pointers; free search gives full/empty.

groups.name: Push/pop control
groups.description: Combinational push/append and read/pop logic updating both tables.

groups.name: Exists lookup
groups.description: Masked compare of query data against all occupied entries.
